original: The crew did not descend.
paraphrase: The crew maintained altitude.
changed: The crew descended.

original: The first officer did not read back the altitude clearance.
paraphrase: The first officer failed to repeat the altitude assignment to the controller.
changed: The first officer read back the altitude clearance.

original: TCAS did not issue a resolution advisory.
paraphrase: No RA was generated by the collision avoidance system.
changed: TCAS issued a resolution advisory.

original: The captain did not reject the takeoff.
paraphrase: The captain continued the takeoff.
changed: The captain rejected the takeoff.

original: We were not cleared to cross Runway 27.
paraphrase: We had no clearance to cross Runway 27.
changed: We were cleared to cross Runway 27.

original: The controller never issued a traffic alert.
paraphrase: ATC gave no traffic advisory at any point.
changed: The controller issued a traffic alert.

original: The landing gear did not extend.
paraphrase: The gear failed to come down.
changed: The landing gear extended.

original: The autopilot did not capture the altitude.
paraphrase: The automation failed to level off at the selected altitude.
changed: The autopilot captured the altitude.

original: The engine fire warning did not go out after we pulled the handle.
paraphrase: After pulling the fire handle, the engine fire light stayed on.
changed: The engine fire warning went out after we pulled the handle.

original: The crew did not complete the before-landing checklist.
paraphrase: The before-landing checklist was left unfinished by the pilots.
changed: The crew completed the before-landing checklist.

original: We did not hear the frequency change instruction.
paraphrase: The instruction to switch frequencies was missed by us.
changed: We heard the frequency change instruction.

original: The aircraft was not de-iced before departure.
paraphrase: The airplane departed without receiving de-icing.
changed: The aircraft was de-iced before departure.

original: The flight attendants did not arm the doors.
paraphrase: The cabin crew left the doors disarmed.
changed: The flight attendants armed the doors.

original: The pilot had not obtained a weather briefing.
paraphrase: No weather briefing was received by the pilot.
changed: The pilot had obtained a weather briefing.

original: The tower did not clear us to land.
paraphrase: We had no landing clearance from the tower.
changed: The tower cleared us to land.

original: The maintenance item was not deferred in the logbook.
paraphrase: Nobody entered a deferral for the maintenance item in the logbook.
changed: The maintenance item was deferred in the logbook.

original: The crew did not declare an emergency.
paraphrase: No emergency was declared by the pilots.
changed: The crew declared an emergency.

original: The stall warning did not activate.
paraphrase: The stick shaker stayed silent.
changed: The stall warning activated.

original: We did not have the runway in sight at minimums.
paraphrase: At decision altitude the runway was not visible to us.
changed: We had the runway in sight at minimums.

original: The fuel imbalance was not corrected.
paraphrase: The fuel imbalance remained uncorrected.
changed: The fuel imbalance was corrected.

original: The controller did not notice the altitude deviation.
paraphrase: The altitude deviation went unnoticed by ATC.
changed: The controller noticed the altitude deviation.

original: The passenger was not wearing a seatbelt.
paraphrase: The passenger's seatbelt was unfastened.
changed: The passenger was wearing a seatbelt.

original: The aircraft did not stop before the hold short line.
paraphrase: The airplane rolled past the hold short line.
changed: The aircraft stopped before the hold short line.

original: The crew did not receive the updated arrival clearance.
paraphrase: The revised arrival clearance never reached the crew.
changed: The crew received the updated arrival clearance.

original: The anti-ice was not turned on during the climb.
paraphrase: The anti-ice remained off while climbing.
changed: The anti-ice was turned on during the climb.

original: Descend to six thousand feet.
paraphrase: Reduce altitude to 6,000 ft.
changed: Descend to four thousand feet.

original: We were cleared to climb to FL350.
paraphrase: ATC cleared us up to flight level 350.
changed: We were cleared to climb to FL370.

original: Cross BAYST at or above 11,000 feet.
paraphrase: The restriction was to be at BAYST no lower than 11,000 ft.
changed: Cross BAYST at or above 13,000 feet.

original: Maintain 3,000 feet until established on the localizer.
paraphrase: Stay at three thousand until you are established on the localizer.
changed: Maintain 5,000 feet until established on the localizer.

original: The aircraft leveled off at 9,000 feet.
paraphrase: The airplane stopped its climb at nine thousand feet.
changed: The aircraft leveled off at 8,000 feet.

original: The assigned altitude was 12,000 feet.
paraphrase: ATC had assigned us twelve thousand feet.
changed: The assigned altitude was 10,000 feet.

original: We descended 300 feet below our assigned altitude.
paraphrase: Our altitude dropped three hundred feet beneath the assigned level.
changed: We descended 800 feet below our assigned altitude.

original: The minimum descent altitude for the approach is 1,200 feet.
paraphrase: The approach's MDA is twelve hundred feet.
changed: The minimum descent altitude for the approach is 1,600 feet.

original: Climb and maintain flight level 240.
paraphrase: Go up to FL240 and stay there.
changed: Climb and maintain flight level 280.

original: The traffic passed 500 feet below us.
paraphrase: The other aircraft went by five hundred feet underneath us.
changed: The traffic passed 1,500 feet below us.

original: The cabin altitude reached 10,000 feet.
paraphrase: Cabin pressure altitude climbed to ten thousand feet.
changed: The cabin altitude reached 14,000 feet.

original: Expect to cross the fix at 250 knots.
paraphrase: Plan on crossing the fix at a speed of 250 kt.
changed: Expect to cross the fix at 210 knots.

original: The airspeed decayed to 120 knots on final.
paraphrase: On final approach our speed dropped to one hundred twenty knots.
changed: The airspeed decayed to 140 knots on final.

original: We set the altimeter to 29.92.
paraphrase: The altimeter setting we used was 29.92 inches.
changed: We set the altimeter to 29.82.

original: The decision height was 200 feet above the ground.
paraphrase: Our DH was two hundred feet AGL.
changed: The decision height was 400 feet above the ground.

original: Visibility was reported as one half mile.
paraphrase: Reported visibility was 1/2 statute mile.
changed: Visibility was reported as three miles.

original: We had 4,500 pounds of fuel remaining at landing.
paraphrase: Fuel on landing was forty-five hundred pounds.
changed: We had 2,500 pounds of fuel remaining at landing.

original: The controller assigned 7,000 feet but we climbed to 8,000.
paraphrase: ATC gave us seven thousand, yet the aircraft went up to eight thousand.
changed: The controller assigned 7,000 feet but we climbed to 9,000.

original: The runway is 6,000 feet long.
paraphrase: The runway has a length of six thousand feet.
changed: The runway is 9,000 feet long.

original: Our clearance was to descend via the arrival to 11,000.
paraphrase: We were cleared to descend via the STAR down to eleven thousand feet.
changed: Our clearance was to descend via the arrival to 17,000.

original: The aircraft overshot its altitude by 400 feet.
paraphrase: The airplane went 400 ft past the assigned level.
changed: The aircraft overshot its altitude by 1,400 feet.

original: Wind was 270 at 15 gusting 25.
paraphrase: The wind came from 270 degrees at fifteen knots with gusts to twenty-five.
changed: Wind was 270 at 15 gusting 45.

original: We were descending at 3,000 feet per minute.
paraphrase: Our descent rate was three thousand fpm.
changed: We were descending at 1,000 feet per minute.

original: Hold at 14,000 feet.
paraphrase: Enter the holding pattern at fourteen thousand feet.
changed: Hold at 16,000 feet.

original: The ceiling was 800 feet overcast.
paraphrase: There was an overcast layer at eight hundred feet.
changed: The ceiling was 2,800 feet overcast.

original: Turn left heading 240.
paraphrase: Make a left turn to heading 240.
changed: Turn right heading 240.

original: The aircraft drifted to the right of the centerline.
paraphrase: The airplane wandered right of the runway centerline.
changed: The aircraft drifted to the left of the centerline.

original: TCAS commanded a climb.
paraphrase: The resolution advisory told us to go up.
changed: TCAS commanded a descent.

original: Exit the runway to the left at taxiway Bravo.
paraphrase: Turn off the runway leftward onto taxiway B.
changed: Exit the runway to the right at taxiway Bravo.

original: We entered a right downwind for Runway 18.
paraphrase: We joined the downwind on the right side for Runway 18.
changed: We entered a left downwind for Runway 18.

original: The traffic was at our two o'clock, passing from right to left.
paraphrase: The other airplane appeared ahead off our right side and crossed toward our left.
changed: The traffic was at our two o'clock, passing from left to right.

original: ATC instructed us to descend to avoid the traffic.
paraphrase: The controller told us to go lower to stay clear of the other aircraft.
changed: ATC instructed us to climb to avoid the traffic.

original: The left engine failed on takeoff.
paraphrase: We lost the number one engine during the takeoff.
changed: The right engine failed on takeoff.

original: The aircraft departed the runway on the left side.
paraphrase: The airplane ran off the left edge of the runway.
changed: The aircraft departed the runway on the right side.

original: We were vectored north of the storm.
paraphrase: ATC gave us headings that took us around the north side of the thunderstorm.
changed: We were vectored south of the storm.

original: The wind shear caused the aircraft to sink.
paraphrase: The windshear made the airplane lose altitude.
changed: The wind shear caused the aircraft to climb.

original: The pilot turned right instead of continuing straight ahead.
paraphrase: Instead of flying straight, the pilot made a right turn.
changed: The pilot turned left instead of continuing straight ahead.

original: We were cleared for the parallel runway on the right.
paraphrase: Our clearance was for the right-hand parallel runway.
changed: We were cleared for the parallel runway on the left.

original: The airplane rolled to the left after encountering wake turbulence.
paraphrase: Wake turbulence caused a roll to the left.
changed: The airplane rolled to the right after encountering wake turbulence.

original: The aircraft was east of the assigned course.
paraphrase: The airplane was off course to the east.
changed: The aircraft was west of the assigned course.

original: The trim moved nose down without command.
paraphrase: The trim ran in the nose-down direction on its own.
changed: The trim moved nose up without command.

original: Hold southwest of the fix with left turns.
paraphrase: Enter the holding pattern on the southwest side of the fix using left turns.
changed: Hold southwest of the fix with right turns.

original: We were climbing when the other aircraft passed overhead.
paraphrase: The traffic flew over us during our climb.
changed: We were descending when the other aircraft passed overhead.

original: The aircraft turned toward the higher terrain.
paraphrase: The airplane headed into the rising ground.
changed: The aircraft turned away from the higher terrain.

original: The controller issued a turn to the left for spacing.
paraphrase: ATC gave us a left turn to increase spacing.
changed: The controller issued a turn to the right for spacing.

original: The indicator showed we were above the glide slope.
paraphrase: We were high on the glide slope according to the indicator.
changed: The indicator showed we were below the glide slope.

original: The airplane was pushed back toward the north.
paraphrase: The tug pushed the aircraft back in a northerly direction.
changed: The airplane was pushed back toward the south.

original: Turn left to intercept the localizer.
paraphrase: Make a left turn to join the localizer course.
changed: Turn right to intercept the localizer.

original: The aircraft overshot the final approach course to the east.
paraphrase: The airplane flew through the final course and ended up east of it.
changed: The aircraft overshot the final approach course to the west.

original: The pilot pulled the nose up to avoid the bird.
paraphrase: To miss the bird, the pilot raised the nose.
changed: The pilot pushed the nose down to avoid the bird.

original: The aircraft leveled off, then turned.
paraphrase: After leveling off, it turned.
changed: The aircraft turned, then leveled off.

original: We received the clearance and then started the descent.
paraphrase: The descent began only after the clearance was issued.
changed: We started the descent and then received the clearance.

original: The crew ran the checklist before shutting down the engine.
paraphrase: The engine was shut down after the crew completed the checklist.
changed: The crew shut down the engine before running the checklist.

original: The controller issued the turn after the aircraft had passed the fix.
paraphrase: The aircraft was already past the fix when the turn instruction came.
changed: The controller issued the turn before the aircraft had passed the fix.

original: The engine failed and then the fire warning sounded.
paraphrase: The fire warning sounded after the engine failure.
changed: The fire warning sounded and then the engine failed.

original: We landed before the tower issued a landing clearance.
paraphrase: The tower's landing clearance came after we had already touched down.
changed: We landed after the tower issued a landing clearance.

original: The first officer extended the flaps, then lowered the gear.
paraphrase: Flaps came out first, followed by the landing gear.
changed: The first officer lowered the gear, then extended the flaps.

original: The TCAS alert came after we had started the climb.
paraphrase: We were already climbing when TCAS alerted.
changed: The TCAS alert came before we had started the climb.

original: The crew declared an emergency and then diverted to Denver.
paraphrase: After declaring an emergency, the crew diverted to Denver.
changed: The crew diverted to Denver and then declared an emergency.

original: The aircraft crossed the hold short line before the clearance was given.
paraphrase: The clearance was given only after the aircraft had passed the hold short line.
changed: The aircraft crossed the hold short line after the clearance was given.

original: We were de-iced and then waited an hour for takeoff.
paraphrase: Following de-icing, we waited an hour before departing.
changed: We waited an hour and then were de-iced for takeoff.

original: The passenger became ill after takeoff.
paraphrase: Once airborne, the passenger fell sick.
changed: The passenger became ill before takeoff.

original: The captain took control after the first officer flared too high.
paraphrase: When the first officer flared too high, the captain then took over.
changed: The first officer flared too high after the captain took control.

original: The autopilot disconnected and then the aircraft began to roll.
paraphrase: The airplane started rolling once the autopilot had disconnected.
changed: The aircraft began to roll and then the autopilot disconnected.

original: We switched frequencies before acknowledging the altitude change.
paraphrase: The altitude change was acknowledged only after we had changed frequency.
changed: We acknowledged the altitude change before switching frequencies.

original: The smoke appeared before the circuit breaker tripped.
paraphrase: The breaker popped after smoke had already appeared.
changed: The smoke appeared after the circuit breaker tripped.

original: ATC cancelled the approach clearance, then issued a missed approach.
paraphrase: After cancelling our approach clearance, ATC gave us a missed approach.
changed: ATC issued a missed approach, then cancelled the approach clearance.

original: The aircraft was refueled before the maintenance inspection.
paraphrase: The maintenance inspection took place after refueling.
changed: The aircraft was refueled after the maintenance inspection.

original: The gear was retracted before the aircraft had a positive rate of climb.
paraphrase: The aircraft did not yet show a positive climb rate when the gear came up.
changed: The gear was retracted after the aircraft had a positive rate of climb.

original: We started the engines and then the ground crew removed the chocks.
paraphrase: The chocks were pulled by the ground crew once the engines were running.
changed: The ground crew removed the chocks and then we started the engines.

original: The runway was closed after we had landed.
paraphrase: We touched down, and then the runway was closed.
changed: The runway was closed before we had landed.

original: The flight attendant reported the odor, then the pilots donned oxygen masks.
paraphrase: The pilots put on oxygen masks after the flight attendant reported the odor.
changed: The pilots donned oxygen masks, then the flight attendant reported the odor.

original: The controller amended the clearance after we had programmed the FMS.
paraphrase: We had already loaded the FMS when the controller changed the clearance.
changed: The controller amended the clearance before we had programmed the FMS.

original: The aircraft lost hydraulic pressure and then the flaps stopped moving.
paraphrase: Once hydraulic pressure was lost, the flaps stopped moving.
changed: The flaps stopped moving and then the aircraft lost hydraulic pressure.

original: The bird strike happened before rotation.
paraphrase: We hit the bird while still on the runway prior to rotating.
changed: The bird strike happened after rotation.
